Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Hugely influential artist Gary Baseman has spent a career creating creepy-cute characters within his personal universe, blurring the line between pop culture and fine art. His work explores deep feelings of love, longing, and loss through a lighthearted lens.

On his first-ever Magic cards, he’s brought his signature style to a five-part panorama spread across a cycle of lands—each telling a whimsical story that’s a little playful, a little dark, and all Gary Baseman. If you’re a fan of the sweetly sinister, the disturbingly darling, and the beautifully bittersweet, this drop is for you.

Contents:
• 1x Plains
• 1x Island
• 1x Swamp
• 1x Mountain
• 1x Forest
